answer: Each identity's entry bond is priced by funding-graph position: the first identity pays 20 POA, and every further identity traced to the same source pays k² × 20 POA, k being its arrival order. A garden of clones anchored to one wallet owes 20 × (1²+…+N²) into a crystal ledger escrow. At N=10 a fleet owes 7,700 POA against 200 honest; one flagged clone forfeits the whole family's escrow, while honest entry stays one base bond.
